subject: HydraMed request: scoped deletion attestation and retention carveout for pilot tenant
messages:
From: Leila Ahmed <leila.ahmed@hydramed.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@hydramed.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: scoped retention evidence + attic deletion carveout for pilot tenant

Hi Hiro,

Quick note from the pilot security review: our compliance team needs evidence that Redwood can provide a scoped deletion attestation for a single tenant (HYD-PILOT-4) in the pilot. The ask is narrow — we only need proof that conversation transcripts and user metadata for that tenant can be deleted on request and that any retained forensic/event logs that include patient identifiers are identified and either purged or otherwise documented with compensating controls.

Specifically they asked for:
- A short attestation statement we can include in our vendor file (signed or DocuSign) that Redwood can delete tenant data on request and what the deletion timeline is.
- Artifacts showing how deletions are executed (runbook or playbook).
- Confirmation about backups: are tenant-level backups removed or retained for X days, and how would we prove deletion there?
- SIG/CAIQ or SOC-2 references that map to data deletion controls (we don't need full reports, just the mapping and the relevant pages).

This is a gated item for our security approval — any chance you can provide the above (even as redacted artifacts) within 7 business days?

Thanks,
Leila
Head of Vendor Risk — HydraMed

---
Attachments: none
From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: scoped retention evidence + attic deletion carveout for pilot tenant

Team — forwarding HydraMed's request. Key asks: tenant scoped deletion attestation, runbook artifact, backup retention/erase proof, and mapping to SIG/CAIQ/SOC2 controls. Hydra wants this within 7 business days.

Questions for you:
- Stephanie: can you assemble a short attestation template (we can DocuSign) and a mapping doc linking specific SOC2 controls to our deletion process?
- Priyom: can you confirm from infra whether we can produce a proof-of-delete for a single tenant including backup deltas (HYD-PILOT-4)? If not full proof, what compensating controls exist and what the timeline looks like?
- Marcus: please advise on what redacted artifacts we can share (runbook snippets, logs export, deletion audit trail) without exposing other customers.

I will own the external response and coordinate signatures. Aim: consolidated package by EOD Thursday (2027-08-05) so we hit Hydra's 7-business-day ask.

Thanks — hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: scoped retention evidence + attic deletion carveout for pilot tenant

Hi all,

Quick take — we can produce a clean package for Hydra without exposing other customers. Proposed artifacts:
1) Attestation template (one-page) stating Redwood's ability to perform tenant-scoped deletion, typical timelines (dev/staging: 24h, prod: 72h for deletion pipeline to complete; proofs generation may take up to 5 business days). We can route via DocuSign.
2) Deletion runbook excerpt (redacted) describing the steps: identify tenant objects, revoke access, remove live records, invalidate KV caches, kick correction job to queue thorough erase, and record deletion audit entry.
3) Backup/DR statement: our default backup retention for block-level snapshots is 14 days; immutable cold backups can persist longer depending on provisioning. For a tenant-level immediate deletion attestation we document the backup windows and provide a compensating control: an immutable snapshot review and a deletion certification once the snapshot lifecycle completes or a targeted cryptographic key destruction to render snapshot data inaccessible (if customer requires faster evidence).
4) SIG/CAIQ mapping: we can provide a short table that maps deletion controls to SIG/CAIQ items and point to the relevant pages in our SOC2 report (we'll redact sensitive pages).

Marcus — we'll need one sanitized example of an audit trail (sufficient to show a deletion event for a synthetic tenant) and a statement from infra on whether we can prove removal from cross-region replicas. Priyom — can you confirm the 14-day snapshot default and whether we can offer a KMS key rotation/crypto-scramble as an alternative to physical snapshot deletion for an expedited attestation?

I can draft the attestation and mapping doc today and share for review.

-Stephanie
Director, Customer Reliability
From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: Leila Ahmed <leila.ahmed@hydramed.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@hydramed.com>
Cc: legal@hydramed.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: scoped retention evidence + attic deletion carveout for pilot tenant

Leila / Tom — thanks for the clear list. Putting together a concise package for you. Attached below are the artifacts we'll include (redacted where necessary):

Attachments included (stubs):
- SOC2_Redwood_2027.pdf (redacted - includes control summary pages)
- SIG_Matrix_Redwood.xlsx (mapping of Redwood controls to SIG/CAIQ items)
- retention-deletion-runbook-v2.md (sanitized runbook excerpt showing deletion steps and audit logging)

A few clarifying Qs before we finalize:
1) Scope: you asked for deletion of "conversation transcripts and user metadata" — can you confirm this excludes diagnostic traces and ephemeral metrics? If Hydra wants traces included we will need to expand the artifacts and note longer lead times for cross-region snapshot handling.
2) Backup handling: Hydra, do you prefer (A) an attestation that we will certify deletion once snapshot lifecycle elapses (standard), or (B) a faster cryptographic key-scramble option (requires KMS action and legal sign-off)? Option B provides earlier practical irrecoverability but is a different legal posture.

If you confirm scope = conversation transcripts + user metadata (not diagnostic traces) and preferred backup approach, we'll prepare the DocuSign-ready attestation and the sanitized artifacts. Target delivery: EOD Friday, 2027-08-06 if we have these confirmations.

Regards,
Hiro Tanaka
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: SOC2_Redwood_2027.pdf (stub), SIG_Matrix_Redwood.xlsx (stub), retention-deletion-runbook-v2.md (stub)
From: Leila Ahmed <leila.ahmed@hydramed.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@hydramed.com>, HydraMed Legal <legal@hydramed.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Request: scoped retention evidence + attic deletion carveout for pilot tenant

Thanks, Hiro — the scope is confirmed: conversation transcripts + user metadata only. Diagnostic traces and low-level telemetry are out of scope for this attestation.

Regarding backups: Hydra prefers option B (cryptographic key-scramble) if your team and legal can support it, because we need an earlier form of practical irrecoverability to meet our internal pilot timelines. Please clarify:
- How long does the KMS scramble approach take to make data irrecoverable?
- Will the scramble be scoped to tenant HYD-PILOT-4 only?
- Can you provide a DocuSign attestation for the scramble action and a timeline for proof generation?

We appreciate the quick turnaround — can you confirm whether you can provide the attestation and supporting artifacts by COB Tuesday (2027-08-10)?

Best,
Leila
From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Hydra wants KMS-scramble for HYD-PILOT-4 and DocuSign attestation (urgent)

Team — Hydra confirmed scope and is requesting option B (KMS cryptographic scramble) scoped to tenant HYD-PILOT-4 and a DocuSign attestation by COB Tuesday (2027-08-10). Action items: 
- Priyom: urgently confirm whether the KMS-scramble process can be targeted to a single tenant's encryption key and how long irrecoverability is guaranteed after rotation/destruction. If there are interdependent replicas, we need details on cross-region key wrapping and timeline.
- Marcus: prepare one redacted sample deletion audit entry for a synthetic tenant and confirm we can produce proof artifacts without exposing other customers.
- Stephanie: draft the one-page attestation, include language describing the scramble and that a certification will follow once an infra ticket completes. We'll need legal review — I'll coordinate with Hydra's legal for the DocuSign envelope link.

This is an escalation because of the DOCS requirement; please treat as high priority. I'll loop in our legal if Priyom confirms technical feasibility.

Thanks — hiro
